race.comment: ROCK ANGEL (3) is the horse to beat, having placed on debut here, finishing just over a length behind despite a rough start. A recent trial win in Rockhampton shows he's fit and has significant improvement potential. COSMIC DYNASTY (7) poses the main threat, finishing third at Bowen as favorite and having a valid excuse for her wide run at Bairnsdale, but she needs to turn consistent maiden form into a victory. WILLOW CAPRI (10) offers solid local stats, with two placings from five starts here and a close second recently; her fresh record at this distance could translate into a win if she's in form. MAJESTIC CHOICE (9) showed improvement, finishing fourth at Bowen after a poor run at Ewan. Though her wide barrier and limited wins are concerns, her recent form makes her a contender.
